description: Machine-readable inventory of everything this repository deploys. `bin/dsh` reads this file; update it whenever an artifact is added or moved.

artifacts.notes: User-global instruction file. Loaded before every project AGENTS.md; the ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md copy is intentionally not used so the file stays tool-agnostic.
Compact rules 1-7 for subagent prompts. Not auto-loaded by DSH; AGENTS.md points to it and must be read on demand.
Each first-level directory becomes ~/.agents/skills/<name> -> repo. DSH ranks user-agents skills at 500, below project skills and above bundled skills.

Third-party skills are never vendored. Each pack is cloned at its pinned commit into the agent workspace (<agentWorkspace.target>/tools/skill-packs/<pack>) and only the selected skill directories are linked into the same ~/.agents/skills tree. `bin/dsh skills sync` materializes it; `apply` and `link` run it unless --no-packs is passed. Links carry the upstream LICENSE and history inside the clone.
The profile patch layer: models, UI, tool and agent settings. DSH and the Web Settings page also write this file, so run `bin/dsh capture` after changing settings in the app.
Profile bundles in dsh.profile.bundles (ordered, later wins) and third-party bundle dependencies.
pnpm settings for the profile (node linker, allowBuilds).

plugins.notes: Client-only Web bundle that pins workspaces to the top of the sidebar. Canonical source is this directory. Installed in the desktop profile as a link: dependency; `bin/dsh apply --with-plugins` links this directory on a target machine and selects the bundle. Restart DSH afterwards.

Host + Web Client bundle implementing /btw side questions: fork the current session, answer read-only in a composer bubble, persist topics, and never write to the main transcript. Built artifacts live in lib/; rebuild with the bundled Node/pnpm and commit lib/ when src/ changes. Installed as a link: dependency by `bin/dsh apply --with-plugins`; restart DSH afterwards.

Configuration-only bundle that inserts the Parallel MCP client row (serverName parallel-mcp, anonymous streamable-http endpoint). Ships no Host or Client code; installed as a link: dependency by `bin/dsh apply --with-plugins` and selected in dsh.profile.bundles.

Configuration-only bundle that inserts the Playwright MCP stdio row (serverName playwright). Requires the machine-local tool at /opt/agents/tools/playwright-mcp, provisioned by `tools/provision_playwright_mcp.py`; the row contains absolute runtime and tool paths.
Configuration-only bundle that inserts the Context7 MCP client row (serverName context7, anonymous remote endpoint). No API key is stored.
Configuration-only bundle that inserts the Cloudflare API MCP client row (serverName cloudflare) as a stdio mcp-remote bridge, because the endpoint needs OAuth and DSH's MCP client has no OAuth flow.

mcp.notes: MCP servers are plugin rows, either directly in the profile patch or inserted by a configuration-only bundle under harness/plugins/. servers.yaml is the human inventory that must stay in sync with both.

agentWorkspace.notes: Machine-level helper workspace required by AGENTS.md section 7. Provision explicitly with tools/provision_agents.py; it is not deployed by bin/dsh apply.
